description: A complete model value object as served by a Prompt Cult proxy. Complete means: everything a harness needs to decide to use it, including which credential the proxy spends on its behalf. Disabled models are never listed or served; enabled=false appears here only in config-facing contexts (model overrides), never in discovery responses.

metadata.id: the proxy-visible model ID a harness uses in requests. Proxies serving multiple endpoints from one vendor MAY prefix IDs (go-*, zen-*) to disambiguate.
metadata.upstream_model_id: the ID forwarded upstream when it differs from id (e.g. after prefix stripping); absent means the upstream ID equals id.
metadata.api_key_env_var: denormalized from the owning service so a model object is self-contained; must equal the service's api_key_env_var.
metadata.preference: operator's user preference for this model: pinned = top of list, default = the service's default pick, hidden = excluded from listing but still requestable. Reserved (forward-compatible) - consumers MUST tolerate these fields being absent.
metadata.cost_*: informational pricing (USD per million tokens); reserved for future cost-aware routing; consumers MUST tolerate absence.
metadata.skills: reserved for future per-model skill advertisement; consumers MUST tolerate absence.
metadata.base_instructions: system prompt served with the model; the proxy is the source of truth for custom system prompts, not the harness.
